candidates.change_summary: Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount+=2 so that the increment differs and the observable depositsCount diverges from the original after a receive call.
Delete depositsCount++ so that the counter never increments, making depositsCount always 0 after any receive call instead of the expected value.
Delete the overflow check require statement so that depositsCount increments even on overflow, potentially changing its value from the original revert behavior.
Replace the require condition with a constant true, removing protection and allowing depositsCount to increment even on overflow, changing behavior when overflow would have reverted.
Delete the line that calls withdraw, so withdrawAll becomes a no-op.
Replace `address(this).balance` with `0`, so withdrawAll withdraws nothing.
Remove the require statement from onlyOwner, making it accessible to anyone.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll, allowing anyone to call it.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier check from withdraw(uint) to allow anyone to call it
Replace msg.sender with owner in the transfer call so funds go to owner instead of caller
Replace transfer with call{value: _value}("") to change failure mode from automatic revert to returning false
Replace _value with 0 so that withdraw always transfers zero
Delete the require statement so modifier onlyOwner never reverts
Replace msg.sender == owner with false so onlyOwner always reverts
